The '''fishery''' [[workshop]] handles the preparation of raw [[fish]]. This process yields prepared fish, [[turtle|turtles]], and [[cave lobster|lobsters]], and will additionally give [[shell|shells]] in the case of turtles, oysters, and other shelled animals.

==Menu==
'''Fishery'''

*{{k|p}} :Process a Raw Fish
*{{k|e}} :Extract from a Raw Fish
*{{k|f}} :Capture a Live Fish

==Notes==
*The preparation task is automated by default, a procedure that can be changed with {{key|o}}[[Standing orders|rders]], {{key|W}}orkshop Orders, Auto {{key|f}}ishery.
* Using the Capture Live Fish task when water sources are frozen results in a fisherdwarf (or any [[Noble]] who 'volunteers' to help the community by helping out the poor, poor, peasants) spending the season outside and holding the trap.
* Without an available [[animal trap]], the Capture Live Fish task will stop automated fish preparations.
